fusions.name: Tail Up, Hooves Out
fusions.desc: A kick from both hind hooves with your tail raised that deals 11 damage, knocks the target back 2.5 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds, with a 50% chance to leave it [Fatigued] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Team Leans In
fusions.desc: Sprays a ring of musk that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies pull together and deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Nosebag Rest
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Rank in the Traces
fusions.desc: A bonded heidel fights beside you, kicking enemies within 3 tiles for 4 damage every 1.8 seconds and leaving them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. You can ride it.
